**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

Section 14.1 is a genuine insurance clause — CGL ($2,000,000 primary limits), fidelity ($10,000,000), workers' compensation as mandated by the state with $500,000 employer's liability, all risk property, plus a certificate-on-request and 30-day cancellation-notice mechanic in 14.1(B). No other insurance provision exists anywhere in the document (searches for "insurance", "errors and omissions", "cyber" and "professional liability" surfaced nothing further).

It nonetheless fails the fallback on a material term: there is no professional liability (E&O) and no cyber/privacy coverage for a vendor that processes our Items and data. The cure is a single inserted item 5 in the 14.1(A) schedule carrying E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000 — the two fallback elements and nothing more. The existing 14.1(B) certificate duty already reaches "the coverage required by this Section", so the new coverages inherit it without any edit to retained text, and I did not volunteer the more onerous preferred limits or CGL split limits.
